scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from official Secrets of Strixhaven pages: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven (character bios), the Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven and Episode 6. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: shadrix_silverquill

quotes.quote: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven University, Shadrix Silverquill is loquacious yet calculated
In establishing Silverquill College, he aimed to train the future leaders of the plane.

claims.summary: Shadrix Silverquill, one of the five founding elder dragons, established Silverquill College.

claims.subject: augusta_sos

quotes.quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

claims.summary: Augusta died in the Phyrexian Invasion, but her summoned spirit still serves as Lorehold's interim dean of order.
claims.limitation: Her bio sits under the page's Lorehold heading and names Lorehold students; the quoted sentence itself does not name the college.

claims.subject: phyrexians

quotes.quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

claims.summary: Augusta died during the Phyrexian Invasion.
claims.limitation: The text says she died in the invasion, not who killed her.

claims.subject: nev

quotes.quote: Twin to Adrix, Nev and his sibling grew up on the Pinzari Isles.

claims.summary: Nev and Adrix are merfolk twins from the Pinzari Isles.

claims.subject: nev

quotes.quote: After the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham, the two were appointed as deans of Quandrix

claims.summary: Nev and Adrix became deans of Quandrix after the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham.

claims.subject: adrix

quotes.quote: After the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham, the two were appointed as deans of Quandrix

claims.summary: Adrix is co-dean of Quandrix with Nev.

claims.subject: moseo

quotes.quote: Moseo willingly stepped up to replace the deceased Valentin as the new dean of the vein.

claims.summary: Moseo replaced the deceased Valentin as Witherbloom's dean of the vein.
claims.limitation: 'Dean of the vein' is one of Witherbloom's two deanships; the college name is from the bio's section heading.

claims.subject: primo

quotes.quote: Primo is Zimone's trusty companion fractal.
taking his role as Zimone's friend and stalwart defender very seriously

claims.summary: Primo is Zimone's companion fractal, friend and defender.

claims.subject: zimone

quotes.quote: Zimone initially summoned Primo because she merely enjoyed his wolflike form

claims.summary: Zimone summoned Primo and, after Duskmourn, would not unsummon him.

claims.subject: ral_zarek

quotes.quote: Ral Zarek is a recently arrived guest lecturer at Silverquill.

claims.summary: Ral Zarek is a guest lecturer at Silverquill.
claims.limitation: He is faculty (guest lecturer), not a student.

claims.subject: killian_lu

quotes.quote: Killian Lu is a Silverquill graduate student, currently mentoring younger students at the Forum of Amity.

claims.summary: Killian Lu, a Silverquill graduate student, mentors younger students at the Forum of Amity.
claims.limitation: He mentors there; formal membership of the Forum is not stated.

claims.subject: tam

quotes.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.
Jadzi, so focused as she was on the spell she was weaving, had never suspected Tam.

claims.summary: Tam pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic while Jadzi was trying to calm the archaic.
claims.limitation: Jadzi's fate after the fall is not resolved in this episode.

claims.subject: tam

quotes.quote: "What did you just do? She was trying to help us!" Lluwen shouted.
Tam bit her lip. She tried to meet their eyes but found that she could not. "I was made to do this."

claims.summary: Tam's friends, Lluwen among them, saw her act as a betrayal; Tam says she was made to do it.
claims.limitation: The episode frames it as betrayal of the group; Tam's motive and maker are not explained here.

claims.subject: lluwen

quotes.quote: And thirteen nights exploring Titan's Grave with Lluwen.

claims.summary: Before the betrayal, Tam and Lluwen were friends who explored Titan's Grave together.

claims.subject: strixhaven_founder_dragons

quotes.quote: Founded over 700 years ago by five spellcasting dragons, Strixhaven University is Arcavios's premier institution of magical learning

claims.summary: Five spellcasting dragons founded Strixhaven University over 700 years ago.

claims.subject: shadrix_silverquill

quotes.quote: Located in the northeast region of Arcavios, the Forum of Amity was founded by Shadrix Silverquill as a center for diplomacy.

claims.summary: Shadrix Silverquill founded the Forum of Amity in northeast Arcavios as a centre for diplomacy.

claims.subject: dawning_archaic

quotes.quote: The Dawning Archaic was formed from the soul of what will be the last-ever oracle on the plane.
When an oracle dies, their mind and spirit are swept off into the distant past, drawn backward through time toward the intense magical power of the Dawning Age.

claims.summary: Archaics are born in the Dawning Age from the souls of oracles; the Dawning Archaic comes from the last-ever oracle of Arcavios.
claims.limitation: That oracle lies in the plane's future; the pages do not name them.

claims.subject: kirol

quotes.quote: Field study may be separating us for now—but how could it hope to rend apart the bonds of friendship we have woven together in Lorwyn?
I'm glad you're having so much fun, Kirol.

claims.summary: In letters during field study, Abigale, Kirol, Tam and their friends recall the bonds of friendship they formed in Lorwyn.
claims.limitation: Some letter writers are not named in the quoted lines; the friendship is inferred from the exchange.

claims.subject: professor_fel

quotes.quote: Professor Fel's voice was as rich as fresh soil and as cool as loam.
Professor Fel hauled Lluwen up by his scruff.

claims.summary: Professor Fel leads the field-study class that Lluwen is part of.

claims.subject: abigale

quotes.quote: Has there been any sign of Lluwen? she signed, her words broadcast telepathically by her hearing aid.
Just ahead, past the landing bay, the dig site was in total disarray.

claims.summary: At the Titan's Grave dig site, Abigale (who signs, with a telepathic hearing aid) searches for the missing Lluwen.

claims.subject: tam

quotes.quote: That bulky frame hurling boughs off the trapped students could only be Kirol.
"I hope you're wearing your hiking boots," said Kirol.

claims.summary: Tam and Kirol work together after a collapse traps students.
claims.limitation: Alliance is inferred from their joint action in the scene.

claims.subject: ajani

quotes.quote: Who was he as a teacher if he could not bring himself to mentor Chandra here?
Chandra wanted nothing more than to be seen as an equal, yet he could not bring himself to respect her decisions here.

claims.summary: Ajani travels with Chandra and struggles with his role as her teacher and mentor.
claims.limitation: The text frames this as Ajani's doubt about mentoring her, not a settled relationship.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

quotes.quote: No longer was she walking through subterranean caverns on Arcavios—no, now she was somewhere else.

claims.summary: Chandra is on Arcavios during the Secrets of Strixhaven story.

claims.subject: jilesa_clarus

quotes.quote: "Jilesa Clarus," she said, holding out her hand.
"Reporter from the Strixhaven Star, here for the interview.
A pleasure to meet you, Professor Zarek."

claims.summary: Jilesa Clarus, a Strixhaven Star reporter, interviews Professor Ral Zarek.

claims.subject: summitfest

quotes.quote: Most of the tents are stamped with the Prismari crest, although as the month goes on there are more and more outsiders joining the festival.
Most Prismari students aren't invited until they're upperclassmen.

claims.summary: Summitfest is a month-long Prismari festival with a showcase at the end of the month.
claims.limitation: 'Hosted by' is inferred from the Prismari crest and invitations; the narrator is unnamed in these lines.

claims.subject: quintorius

quotes.quote: Looking at Quintorius Kand, she felt as if, despite the background of chaos and the invasion, this might have turned out to be one of those times.
Quint had always struck her as the sort of scholar Lorehold excelled at producing: dedicated, intelligent, and disinclined to change the world.

claims.summary: Quintorius Kand, a loxodon geomancer, is a Lorehold scholar returning to the Lorehold campus.
claims.limitation: Membership is given through another character's view of him.

claims.subject: zimone

quotes.quote: She was top of her class, she saved the school, she spent her thesis with the Firemind himself.
Ravnican apartments are notoriously expensive.

claims.summary: After graduating, Zimone, who did her thesis with the Firemind (Niv-Mizzet), lives in a cramped Ravnican apartment.
claims.limitation: The Firemind is identified with Niv-Mizzet by his standard epithet, not by name in this quote.

claims.subject: killian_lu

quotes.quote: They studied each other as they drew their sigils overhead, part of Forum tradition: the emblems declared the factions they represented (Doradur for Killian; Pinzari for his opponent) and the terms ("satisfaction"—for whatever that was worth).

claims.summary: Killian Lu fights a Forum duel representing Doradur against a Pinzari opponent.

claims.subject: dina

quotes.quote: And these were Witherbloom students: comfortable, the saying went, in Death's house.
True, it wasn't a species Dina had ever seen before—eight feet long, legs thick as a man's, shaggy-feathered with a predator's beak.

claims.summary: Dina and her friends are Witherbloom students.
claims.limitation: Dina's membership is inferred from the group description.

remaining: Every SOS page is cited with one to three claims; the episode plots (Titan's Grave collapse, Lluwen's disappearance, the threat to Arcavios) are only lightly modelled
Who made Tam and what happened to Jadzi after the fall need later pages
